segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, quick check on Northstar Foods. They asked for the renewal proposal by end of day, 68 seats, same package, term starting December 15.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Got it. Is that the one with the extra support hours, or was that separate?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Separate. For this one it’s just the standard 12 months, net 45, and they want invoices split quarterly because finance is tightening up Q1 spend.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Any discount change from last year?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Keeping the 8% renewal discount. I’m just making sure the 68 seats, December 15 start, net 45, and quarterly invoice notes all match in the CRM, the pricing sheet, the deal desk form, and the billing request before I send it over.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Makes sense. If deal desk pushes back, tell them procurement already approved that structure last June.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I’ve got the email from Erin on their side. Also, they asked if the signature date can be November 22, but service start stays December 15.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: That’s fine. Just don’t let the proposal say immediate start.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, exactly. I’ll send you the PDF first for a sanity check, then I’ll get it to Erin before 4:30.
